messages.author: 0c355e8d6454514b
messages.subject: Stuck with installation
parts:
I am stuck with the installation at point 3.1 (http://rapache.net/
manual.html#Installation):

Installation following steps under "2.3 Quick Install for Debian/
Ubuntu" on a Ubuntu 10.04 server works fine. All the steps work until
point "3.1 R_module".

After inserting the LoadModule directive into httpd.conf and starting
apache, I keep getting the error:

httpd: Syntax error on line 147 of /usr/local/apache2/conf/httpd.conf:
Cannot load /usr/lib/apache2/module /mod_R.so into server: /usr/lib/
apache2/modules/mod_R.so: undefined symbol: ap_log_rerror

Although different from the error on the rapache.net page concerning
libR.so, I nevertheless changed the file /etc/ld.so.conf, although to
no avail.

Do you have any idea what might be wrong?

> After inserting the LoadModule directive into httpd.conf and starting

>
> httpd: Syntax error on line 147 of /usr/local/apache2/conf/httpd.conf:
> Cannot load /usr/lib/apache2/module /mod_R.so into server: /usr/lib/
> apache2/modules/mod_R.so: undefined symbol: ap_log_rerror

Sounds like you've got a custom system. Did you install apache2 from
source and install into /usr/local/apache2? The steps in the manual
refer to the packaged version of apache2 where the conf files are
stored in /etc/apache2/.

Jeff
